ticker_news.title: Top Analyst Says Oracle's 'Irresponsible' AI Bet Differs From 'Healthy' Microsoft And Google Demand: A 'Bad Business' With 'Very Low Margins'
ticker_news.description: Technology analyst Gil Luria criticized Oracle's AI strategy as a 'bad business' with low margins, contrasting it with Microsoft, Amazon, and Google's more established AI approaches. The analyst questioned Oracle's massive $455 billion order backlog and AI deal credibility.
ticker_news.author: Rishabh Mishra

ticker_news.title: Could Investing $10,000 in D-Wave Quantum Make You a Millionaire?
ticker_news.description: D-Wave Quantum, a quantum computing company, has seen explosive stock growth of over 1,700% in the past year. While promising, the company has minimal revenue and analysts suggest commercially viable quantum computing might not be feasible until 2040.
ticker_news.author: Will Ebiefung
